why: Akien, 2026-08-08: 'now there was supposed to be a second part to the inference proxy. domains.' The rules stack that closed yesterday answers WHERE and at-what-cost an inference runs; nothing yet answers WITH WHAT CONTENT a request arrives — every request crosses the sole path naked, and the escalate-to-LLM pattern the idea names is already built three separate times unberthed (orient.deepen's failover, learning_block's decide-or-escalate, learning/'s tiered recall), each caller re-deriving what a domain would answer once (Law 1). The lived symptom nearest to hand: the librarian's chat turn — live on Hex at 4.0s since yesterday — has nowhere to say 'this is research'; any research-shaped behavior would be hand-built prompt scaffolding at the call site.

watchme.trigger: every generate/resolve row the proxy's own cache (inference_calls, read through db_domain — no new instrument, Law 1) records after an era floor set at the MEASURED GO-LIVE of the domained route (the serving restart, never the disk landing — the 2026-08-08 stale-process lesson written into the spec). Fires when a post-era row lacks a domain marker in its provenance — a request crossed the sole path undomained.
watchme.enough: cleared when, across >= 12 post-era rows, every row carries a domain marker AND at least one row carries a NON-default domain chosen by a real caller (the librarian's research turn). The second clause is the non-vacuity tooth: default-stamping every row cannot clear this watch — only a real consumer naming a real vertical can.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — the finding names the row count, the undomained canonical(s) if any, which domains were observed riding, and the suggestion
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the finding rides to harbor_master as an efficacy question about whether the verticals are real (falsifier tells 5 and 6 are what it would surface)
watchme.consumer: Akien at the register, and the future fail-over-to-LLM consumers (inspectors) whose tickets the horizon names — the watch's evidence tells them the seam is ready

falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a caller names a domain and the request arrives without that domain's prompts/escalation actually applied (domains decorative — the 'stacks exist but a literal decides' defect one seam up); (2) the librarian's real chat turn cannot ride a research domain; (3) a bare call breaks or behaves differently than before the build (general is not actually the default); (4) domain logic branches per caller inside inference_domain (the boundary sentence breached — reasoning leaked out of the calling device); (5) every consumer mints its own bespoke domain (the vertical is not real — per-device config wearing a class name); (6) a device wants to compose aspects across two domains (domains are FIELD SETS an instance composes, not classes it belongs to — the ticket/probe/task precedent — and the shape must dissolve).
horizon: Re-read at: the first non-librarian consumer (an inspector failing over to LLM with learning — those tickets cast when the consumer appears, per the idea's own 'could result in tickets'); the first appearance of a subclass need ('different kinds of research' — does it compose rows or demand a hierarchy?); any resurfacing of the domain-naming distinction (recorded in the sorted berth's collision check: ownership-sense vs subject-sense, disambiguated by address, standing for Akien's overrule).
